8211949.author: adrianocp
8211949.reason: Two asks: a configurable bar maximum (the real shield size) and a sound when the shield drops to 0.
8211949.text:
Hi... First of all, thanks for the addon. I just downloaded it and it's being already useful...

I have 2 questions. First, is it possible to define the max value of the bar that represents the full shield? For example, in my case, when I cast the ice barrier, the bar shows 174k of shield, but the bar is in the middle, like the total would be 350k or something like that. I'm not sure who the maximum bar value is calculated, but it'd be good if the maximum is the real full shield health..

Second, is it possible to configure a sound that plays when the shields goes to 0? Having the visual bar is great, but sometimes I'm paying attention on other things, mobs, etc, and having a sound alerting when the shield is gone would be really helpful.
Or, if it possible, the same sound when the shield ends so, it goes to 0 anyway. I'm not sure if it'd be the same trigger, but both situations would be good.. About the sound, I have no idea if it's possible, but it'd be good if the sound could be the spell name, the text to speech, something similar to sound alerts in the cooldown manager.
